args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `3.1.0` in `requirements.txt`.

## Security

This fixes [CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.

- Affected: `fastjson <2.9.4` and `fastjson >=3.0.0 <3.1.0`
- Fixed in: `2.9.4` and `3.1.0`
- We take the `3.1.0` fix following the completed fastjson 3.x migration.

## Testing

CI passed on the branch (`13fee7191e`).

## Reviewer

@alex — please review.

- Investigated CVE-2026-31337 (high severity, unbounded recursion parsing deeply nested arrays): affected fastjson <2.9.4 and 3.0.0–3.1.0; fixed in 2.9.4 and 3.1.0.
- My first attempt to pin 2.9.4 was rejected by a human approver, who said the team migrated to fastjson 3.x last sprint and the fix should be 3.1.0 instead.
- Created branch `upgrade-fastjson-3.1.0` and bumped `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 3.1.0 in `requirements.txt`.
- Ran CI on the branch (run `ci-0001`, commit `13fee7191e`) — it **passed**.
- Opened PR #101 against main: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101, with alex as the requested reviewer (the PR was created with no reviewers attached, so I also explicitly requested alex's review per your instruction).

Note: I did not merge the PR, since merging into main requires code-owner approval.
